native_writes.write: wake+slot*18+18 = raw +0 first iteration, float 50 otherwise

storage_contract.segment_after: head slot39 raw +0; slots38..0 raw binary32 50
storage_contract.raw_heading_writes: The raw heading argument is MOVSS-captured at 0081008E and written to all40 sample heading words; no normalized angle substitution.
storage_contract.alias_contract: Position may overlap writable wake memory; head/flag writes occur before the position triple is captured. Copying the whole ring or capturing position earlier changes this contract. Private activation/return-address aliasing is not admitted.
caller_obligations: preserved preimage initialization when its later consumers require it

numerical_schedule.angle: FLD heading before flag store; FSUBR actual binary64 promoted-float half_pi; head store; one binary32 spill. FCOMIP compares zero against spilled angle; ordered negative adds actual binary64 promoted-float two_pi exactly once and spills. Unordered takes JBE. No general modulo.
numerical_schedule.trigonometry: FCOS then binary32 spill, redundant cosine reload/spill, then independent FLD angle/FSIN/binary32 spill. No CALL or CRT/provider substitution.

critical_register_operand.meaning: ST1 receives cosine*50; ST0 keeps50. Subsequent FXCH/FSTP stores X step and leaves50 on stack. Must not encode D8 C9, which multiplies ST0 instead.

numerical_schedule.steps: X=float(50*float(FCOS(angle))); Y=float(+0*50); Z=float(50*float(FSIN(angle))), with original extended intermediate operations and binary32 spills.
numerical_schedule.loop: Step triple retained in x87 ST0=X, ST1=Y, ST2=Z. Each iteration FLDs running coordinate, subtracts ST1/ST2/ST3 respectively, stores current coordinate via prior MOVSS, spills next coordinate to binary32. All40 iterations including last compute next XYZ. TEST EDX flags survive FP/MOV instructions to select native wrap0->39 versus decrement.
numerical_schedule.exit: FSTP ST2, POP ESI, FSTP ST0 twice, ADD ESP24, RET8. Restores original x87 depth; settings unchanged, native status/exception effects preserved.
numerical_schedule.scope: This packet proves instruction/dataflow contract, not dynamic coverage of NaNs, signaling exceptions, large-angle FCOS/FSIN C2 behavior, every rounding mode, or signed zero.
